report.explanation: Current gateway telemetry is largely healthy: error_rate 0.0012, p95 77ms, no dependency timeouts or pool waiters, INFO 200 logs. Only one ERROR trace shows a 907ms gateway->order call, and the order service has no direct observations. This is insufficient to substantiate any bounded root cause; downstream order latency is the only lead and needs order-side evidence.
missing_evidence: Order service traces/metrics/logs for the same window to confirm or refute downstream latency
Order-side dependency timings (inventory, payment, postgresql) to localize the 907ms span
Error-rate and latency time series for gateway and order to confirm alert magnitude and onset
Whether the single ERROR trace is representative or an isolated outlier
